logger.message: #['[' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] Duplicate request, returning original ticket']
logger.doc:name: Log duplicate

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ticketId: payload.ticketId, status: payload.status, duplicateOfRequestId: true }

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { categoryCode: vars.ticketRequest.categoryCode, productCode: vars.ticketRequest.productCode, customerTier: vars.customerTier, statedSeverity: vars.ticketRequest.statedSeverity }

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.ticketRequest ++ { requestId: vars.requestId, correlationId: vars.correlationId, customerTier: vars.customerTier, priority: vars.routing.priority, team: vars.routing.team, targetQueue: vars.routing.targetQueue, matchedRuleId: vars.routing.matchedRuleId, priorityReason: vars.routing.priorityReason, isDefaultRoute: vars.routing.isDefaultRoute, ackDueAt: vars.routing.ackDueAt, resolutionDueAt: vars.routing.resolutionDueAt }

%dw 2.0 output application/json fun toIst(val) = if (val == null) null else do { var dt = (val as DateTime default null) --- if (dt != null) ((dt >> "+05:30") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX"}) else (val as String) } var t = vars.savedTicket default payload --- { ticketId: t.ticketId, status: t.status, priority: t.priority, priorityReason: t.priorityReason, matchedRuleId: t.matchedRuleId, team: t.team, targetQueue: t.targetQueue, createdAt: toIst(t.createdAt), ackDueAt: toIst(t.ackDueAt), resolutionDueAt: toIst(t.resolutionDueAt), statusUrl: "/api/v1/tickets/" ++ t.ticketId }

jms:message.jms:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { eventType: "TICKET_ROUTED", eventId: "evt-" ++ uuid(), correlationId: vars.correlationId, routedAt: ((now() >> "+05:30") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX"}), ticketId: vars.savedTicket.ticketId, priority: vars.savedTicket.priority, team: vars.savedTicket.team, matchedRuleId: vars.savedTicket.matchedRuleId, customerId: vars.ticketRequest.customerId, customerTier: vars.customerTier, contactEmail: vars.ticketRequest.contactEmail, productCode: vars.ticketRequest.productCode, categoryCode: vars.ticketRequest.categoryCode, subject: vars.ticketRequest.subject, ackDueAt: vars.savedTicket.ackDueAt, resolutionDueAt: vars.savedTicket.resolutionDueAt, attempt: 1 }]

logger.message: #['[ActiveMQ Offline] Broker not reachable for ' ++ (vars.savedTicket.ticketId default '') ++ '. Ticket persists in Salesforce.']
logger.doc:name: Log broker fallback

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var t = vars.savedTicket default {} --- "[" ++ (t.ticketId default "TICKET") ++ "] " ++ (t.priority default "P3") ++ " – we have your request"

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var t = vars.savedTicket default {} var req = vars.ticketRequest default {} --- "Dear Valued Customer,

" ++ "We have logged your support request and assigned it to our " ++ (t.team default "Support") ++ " team.

" ++ " Ticket Reference : " ++ (t.ticketId default "") ++ "
" ++ " Logged At : " ++ ((t.createdAt as String) default "") ++ "
" ++ " Priority : " ++ (t.priority default "") ++ "
" ++ " Product : " ++ (req.productCode default "") ++ "
" ++ " Category : " ++ (req.categoryCode default "") ++ "

" ++ "What you told us
 " ++ (req.subject default "") ++ "

" ++ "We will respond by " ++ ((t.ackDueAt as String) default "N/A") ++ ". Our current target for a resolution is " ++ ((t.resolutionDueAt as String) default "N/A") ++ ".

" ++ "To add information, reply to this email leaving the subject line unchanged so that it reaches the same ticket. You can also check progress at /api/v1/tickets/" ++ (t.ticketId default "") ++ ".

" ++ (if ((t.priority default "") == "P1") "This request is being handled as a priority one incident. Our on-call engineer has been paged.

" else "") ++ "Regards,
NPN Customer Support
"

logger.message: #['[SMTP Offline] Acknowledgement email could not be delivered for ' ++ (vars.savedTicket.ticketId default '') ++ '. Ticket remains in Salesforce.']
logger.doc:name: Log SMTP fallback

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain var t = vars.savedTicket default {} var req = vars.ticketRequest default {} --- "Ticket : " ++ (t.ticketId default "") ++ "
" ++ "Priority : " ++ (t.priority default "") ++ " (rule " ++ (t.matchedRuleId default "DEFAULT") ++ ")
" ++ "Customer : Valued Customer (" ++ (req.customerId default "") ++ ") – " ++ (vars.customerTier default "STANDARD") ++ "
" ++ "Product : " ++ (req.productCode default "") ++ "
" ++ "Category : " ++ (req.categoryCode default "") ++ "
" ++ "Impact : " ++ ((req.affectedUserCount default 0) as String) ++ " users reported affected

" ++ "Subject
 " ++ (req.subject default "") ++ "

" ++ "Acknowledge by : " ++ ((t.ackDueAt as String) default "N/A") ++ "
" ++ "Resolve by : " ++ ((t.resolutionDueAt as String) default "N/A") ++ "
" ++ "Assigned to : " ++ (t.assignedTo default "UNASSIGNED") ++ "

" ++ "Open in console : /api/v1/tickets/" ++ (t.ticketId default "") ++ "

" ++ (if (t.isDefaultRoute == "Y" or t.isDefaultRoute == true) "NOTE: no routing rule matched this ticket. It has been sent to the triage queue and the rule set needs review.
" ++ " category " ++ (req.categoryCode default "") ++ " / product " ++ (req.productCode default "") ++ "
" ++ " tier " ++ (vars.customerTier default "UNKNOWN") ++ " / severity " ++ (req.statedSeverity default "UNKNOWN") ++ "

" else "")

logger.message: #['[Email Sent] Team notification sent to ' ++ p('report.mgmtEmail')]
logger.doc:name: Log team email sent

logger.message: #['[SMTP Offline] Team notification could not be delivered for ' ++ (vars.savedTicket.ticketId default '') ++ '. Ticket remains in Salesforce.']
logger.doc:name: Log SMTP fallback

logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] Status update for ' ++ vars.ticketId ++ ' to ' ++ vars.newStatus]
logger.doc:name: Log request

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import isAllowed from dwl::StateMachine output application/java --- isAllowed(vars.currentStatus, vars.newStatus)

raise-error.description: #[output text/plain --- 'Invalid transition from ' ++ (vars.currentStatus as String) ++ ' to ' ++ (vars.newStatus as String)]
raise-error.doc:name: Invalid transition

%dw 2.0 output application/java var products = ["PAY-GATEWAY", "MOBILE-APP", "DATA-SYNC", "PAY-GATEWAY-V1"] --- if (products contains vars.productCode) { productCode: vars.productCode } else null
